finding: The source implements adjustable event inspection and exports settings/observations; historical build/deploy success covers packaging, not detector accuracy or biological interpretation.
limitations: Preparation reviews selected records and packaging; it is not a new scientific or hardware test.
Original sources and chronological qualifications must not be flattened into a claim of completed marine or biological validation.
Historical static build success does not validate event detection, biology, calibration or distributed localization.
Dependency implementations and opening audio are external, with exact names/source/audio identity recorded.
Current Whales direction is recorder work; the instrument remains historical reference.
method: Retain source of the linked-view browser prototype and its existing successful static build/deployment record; preserve detector and interpretation limits.
open_questions: What exact new measurement would advance this prototype or question while preserving the stated scope?
